---
description: Run an independent review of a pull request and fix the findings it raises.
argument-hint: "<PR>"
slicekit-managed: v0.0.0-test
---
Run `npx --no-install slicekit instructions review $ARGUMENTS` and follow the brief it prints. The brief is the only source of this command's rules.

Writing rules: `.claude/skills/slicekit-writing/SKILL.md`.
